articles.title: UFO Sighting in a Dead Galaxy!
articles.summary: Authors: Yerong Xu, Malgorzata Siudek, Victor Rodríguez Morales, Mar Mezcua, Hai-cheng Feng, Ciro Pinto, James N. At the center of some galaxies lies a supermassive black hole , accreting the gas and dust around it, called an active galactic nucleus (AGN). AGN are very energetic environments, generating winds and jets that can launch material at thousands of kilometers per second out of their host galaxy. These winds won’t just give you a bad hair day, they can regulate the growth of the entire galaxy by either pushing out interstellar gas and limiting star formation or by compressing interstellar gas and enhancing star formation.
